messages:
eli: Heads-up — saw a weird per-task formatting regression when testing the new AWQ+FP8 candidate on the table-extract workload. Some CSV columns are reordered and a few numeric cells turn into `0.0`.
rachel: ugh, can you paste the exact repro command and sample diff? :mag:
eli: repro below. batch_size=8 seems to trigger it, batch_size=1 looks fine.

```
./run_eval --model awq-fp8-cand --tasks table-extract --batch_size 8 --seed 42 --format csv --save outputs/awq_fp8_bs8.csv
./run_eval --model awq-fp8-cand --tasks table-extract --batch_size 1 --seed 42 --format csv --save outputs/awq_fp8_bs1.csv
```
eli: sample diff (AWQ bs8 vs fp32 baseline):
```
- id, name, amount
- 101, "Widget", 12.34
+ id, amount, name
+ 101, 0.0, "Widget"
```
rachel: hmm interesting. seed 42 same for both, so non-determinism unlikely but batch-dependent. Did you try GPTQ candidate for comparison?
eli: yes. gptq-int8 didn't show the swapping. only AWQ variants (both fp8 and int8 hybrid) show it.
eval-bot: automated eval summary: task=table-extract, n=1200. metrics: fp32=98.9% cols, awq-fp8-bs1=98.6% cols, awq-fp8-bs8=84.2% cols. hallucination-rate rise correlated with bs>=4. See /evals/1934567800_report.json
tom: could be a batching/packer bug where per-example metadata offsets are computed in-place and then reused across batch. I saw similar when we had in-place tokenization buffer reuse (2023 bug).
kai: quick micro-run: toggled packer to clone instead of reuse and bs8 fixed locally.
```
# hacked flag
export RW_PACKER_CLONE=1
./run_eval --model awq-fp8-cand --tasks table-extract --batch_size 8 --seed 42
```
kai: output looks aligned now, metrics ~98.7%
eli: nice. can you post the minimal repro change? maybe a one-line fix in packer.
kai: will open PR. suspect code path: runtime/pack.cc:pack_batch_inplace() — offset calculation uses pointer to local vector and then shifted without resetting for next example.
rachel: assign eng-runtime to triage. @tom can you help with a unit test that simulates variable column widths and multi-example pack? add a golden csv diff check.

eli: from product side, we should mark AWQ+batching as risky for table extraction until runtime fix lands. Can we add a temporary guard that forces batch_size<=1 for that deployment profile?
tom: we can add a policy rule in deployment-profiles: if model.tags contains "awq" and task=="table-extract" then max_batch=1. quick config change.

eval-bot: created ticket: INF-7842 "AWQ batch packing: column reordering at bs>=4" assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://tracker.internal/INF-7842

eli: thanks. action items: kai opens PR for packer fix, tom adds unit test + profile guard, rachel updates rollout risk matrix, I will re-run the full sweep once PR merges. :white_check_mark:
kai: PR 5462 opened: runtime: clone packer buffer when example metadata present. small benchmark impact ~+0.2% latency, no throughput regression in our tests.

rachel: awesome. adding note to model onboarding checklist: "run multi-batch table-extract canary" and add eval that compares column order invariants.
eli: closing thread — will post final numbers after canary. :rocket:
